# LifeKernelOS

> AI-native personal operating system. The product keeps multiple mainline groups, helps a user confirm one current To-do, derives progress from completed To-dos, and aggregates user-confirmed facts into a profile. Human decisions override every document below.

## Start here

- [Agent operating guide](AGENTS.md): mandatory reading order, fact-source precedence, change rules, and verification protocol.
- [Documentation map](docs/README.md): routes a task to its single authoritative document domain.
- [Project overview](README.md): product summary, current implementation status, and local verification commands.

## Current product facts

- [Product entry](docs/product/README.md): product-document scope and update rules.
- [PRD v0.7](docs/product/PRD.md): product intent, mainlines, To-dos, derived progress, profile graph, and acceptance criteria.
- [ADR-0008: mainline groups and derived To-do progress](docs/architecture/decisions/0008-mainline-groups-derived-todo-progress.md): current core domain decision.
- [ADR-0007: two-tab console](docs/architecture/decisions/0007-two-tab-console-information-architecture.md): current information architecture decision.
- [SPEC-0010: mainline To-dos and current action](docs/specs/current/0010-long-term-goals-and-current-action.md): executable contract for the “主线” tab.
- [SPEC-0011: progress-aware profile graph](docs/specs/current/0011-aggregated-profile-graph.md): executable contract for the “我的画像” tab.

## Repository boundaries

- `sources/` is synchronized read-only reference material. Do not edit, move, rename, or delete it.
- Do not infer a third primary tab, a single unique mainline, manual progress percentages, or personality/capability inference. The current product has only “主线” and “我的画像”; settings is an auxiliary account entry.
- Before changing behavior, locate the owning Product, ADR, and Spec document through the routes above. After changes, run `npm run docs:check` and relevant tests.
